title: Caranus son of Philip
summary: Raleigh names Caranus son of Philip in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Caranus, whom others call Philip, sonne of Philip by Cleopatra the Neece of Attalus, whom Olympias caused to be rosted to death. He is not Caranus of Argos. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
